samples.evidence: Sixty-six interviews were transcribed verbatim and analysed using a thematic approach. Table 1. Characteristics of cases included in qualitative study (n = 66). The 66 cases were evenly divided; exactly half had consulted their GP in the month before suicide. Semi-structured interviews with relatives or close friends of 100 suicide victims were conducted as part of a case-controlled psychological autopsy. The views represented in this study are those of bereaved persons.
